content: Standard no-CI static/PHP deploy workflow on shared hosting: build/edit locally, then sync only the output/changed files via FTP or SFTP. lftp mirror (--reverse, --parallel, --only-newer) or an FTP client (FileZilla) are the common tools; rsync/SSH is preferred when available but many budget shared hosts only expose FTP. Keep source (templates/includes) separate from what gets uploaded so raw include fragments aren't accidentally left web-accessible.
